title: RPSC Deputy Jailor Recruitment 2024 – Written & PET Result 2026

shortDescription: RPSC Deputy Jailor Recruitment 2024 written result and PET-to-interview qualified list 2026. Check roll numbers, cut-off marks and document-submission instructions on the official RPSC website.

content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has published result updates for the Deputy Jailor (Prison Department) Competitive Examination 2024.

The written result dated 19 November 2025 lists candidates eligible for the Physical Efficiency Test. The subsequent result dated 02 September 2026 lists 185 candidates provisionally successful for interview after the PET: 2 from the Scheduled Area and 183 from the Non-Scheduled Area.

What shortlisted candidates must do

  1. Download and complete the detailed application form from the RPSC website.
  2. Prepare two copies with the required educational, technical, caste and other certificate photocopies.
  3. Send the documents to the RPSC office by 12 September 2026.
  4. Follow RPSC for the interview date and further document-verification instructions.

Selection process

Pre Exam / written papers are followed by the Physical Efficiency Test, interview, document verification and final merit list, subject to the original recruitment rules.

Cut-off marks

The 02 September 2026 notice includes category-wise cut-offs for the Scheduled and Non-Scheduled Areas. Refer to the official PDF for the complete table.
